name: Migration-anchored value-area break
hypothesis: Buy acceptance above the completed post-migration volume-value area after old holders' selling subsides.
spec: Setup: Trading after migration may establish a new accepted price region. Entry: Buy acceptance above the completed post-migration volume-value area after old holders' selling subsides. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on sustained reentry or new concentrated selling. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
